about.title: About STRAM PESO
about.subtitle: A province-wide employment portal for Marinduque.
about.body: STRAM PESO connects jobseekers, employers, and the six municipalities of Marinduque, built on the province's Labor Market Data and the work of the Public Employment Service Office. It was designed and built as a 4th-year capstone project by students of Marinduque State University — College of Information and Computing Sciences.

danger.title: Account Deactivation
danger.subtitle: Temporarily remove your account from STRAM PESO.
danger.body: Deactivating hides your profile and listings and signs you out. This is reversible — sign in again with your password at any time to reactivate your account.
danger.confirmMessage: Your profile will be hidden and you'll be signed out. Sign back in with your password anytime to reactivate it.
danger.deactivateSuccess: Your account has been deactivated. Sign in again anytime to reactivate it.
danger.deactivateError: Couldn't deactivate your account. Please try again.
